mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.avatar_url, u.password_hash, u.status, u.is_superuser, u.must_change_password, u.deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u WHERE u.username = #{username} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sys_user_session s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{hash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_session WHERE token_hash = #{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_session (user_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{hash}, #{now}, #{expires})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user_session SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE token_hash = #{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_user_session SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, password_changed_at = #{now}, must_change_password = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, password_changed_at = #{now}, status = 1, must_change_password = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND username = 'root' AND is_superuser = 1 AND password_hash IS NULL AND status = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
